children: PLAYSTUDIOS regained compliance with Nasdaq's $1.00 minimum bid requirement following a 1-for-10 reverse stock split.
Nasdaq confirmed Playstudios' Class A common stock closed ≥ $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days (Oct 1–14, 2026).
Company effected a 1-for-10 reverse split of Class A and Class B common stock on Sept 30, 2026; trading adjusted Oct 1.
Regaining compliance closes the November 5, 2025 notice and preserves continued listing on The Nasdaq Capital Market.
